svg.title: Output path and cleanup of a request
svg.desc: Above the line is the output path. EngineCore records the sampled tokens, and the output thread sends them over ZMQ. In the API server, output_handler passes them to OutputProcessor, which detokenizes and checks stop strings, wakes generate, and the handler sends an SSE chunk or JSON. A stop string or a client disconnect sends an abort back to EngineCore. Below the line is cleanup: the scheduler frees the KV blocks, the worker drops the request row on the next step, and the API server drops its request state.

g.text: KV blocks return to the pool
Abort: stop string or client disconnect only
